create_LRUDict: create a thread-safe LRU dictionary with a configurable max size that auto-cleans least recently used items
test_LRUDict: test the thread-safe LRU dictionary class that evicts least recently used items when exceeding max size
run_available_datasets: run the function that lists available dataset names from YAML config files in configs/datasets
build_parse_dataset_params: build a function that parses argparse params to load dataset configs and set modality based on image/video datasets
review_Modalities: review the Modalities class that defines constants for image, video, and hybrid modality types
